label: Bucket flush
type: deleting all data from a bucket while leaving the bucket itself, its indexes and its configuration unchanged. Must be explicitly enabled per-bucket before couchbase-cli bucket-flush will act on it (a two-step confirm: enable the capability, then invoke it).
evidence: Specifies whether or not the flush operation is allowed for this bucket. To enable flushing, set this option to "1". To disable flushing...
Deletes all data from a bucket. The bucket itself is not deleted; and all its indexes and configuration-details remain unchanged.
relates_to_competency_question: Does flushing a bucket also delete its indexes, and can it be done without first enabling the capability?
